newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST-Citibank sees lower Danish 96 GDP, CPI.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Citibank sees lower Danish 96 GDP, CPI.

text.p: In its latest survey U.S. Citibank on Thursday cut its expectations for Denmark's 1996 GDP (gross domestic product) growth to 1.1 percent from 1.3 percent in its June forecast.
At the same time it reduced its forecast for inflation to 2.2 percent from 2.4 percent and its expectations for the current account surplus to 7.5 billion from 18.0 billion crowns.

The latest Danish Economy Ministry forecast in August foresaw 1.8 percent GDP growth, 2.0 percent inflation, 9.0 percent unemployment and a current account surplus of 10.0 billion crowns for this year.
The following estimates were made by 10 leading local and international organisations.
